Q: What is returned or rejected when n is out of range, non-numeric, or the tool name has no matches? Cite file#Lx-Ly.
A: Rejected (resolver returns false). Non-numeric or non-matching syntax fails the regex; #0 and n greater than the count fail the range check; a name with zero matches fails. The failure message is 'tool_result_unavailable' with a hint listing available tool:Name#count entries on the current branch, or 'no tool results on the current branch'. The completion error reports the failing reference as 'evidence reference is unavailable'.
Task: Determine how TaskManage resolves tool:Name#n evidence references in completion answers
tags: Determine how TaskManage resolves tool:Name#n evidence references in completion answers

evidence.quote: if (/^tool:/i.test(reference)) { this.evidenceReason = "tool_result_unavailable: use an exact registered tool name and a current-branch result index" + (this.options.sessionEvidenceHints?.() ?? ""); return this.options.resolveSessionEvidence?.(reference) === true; }
